TV Actor Gaurav Khanna and Akanksha Singh Reportedly Divorcing

Television actor Gaurav Khanna and his wife Akanksha Singh are reportedly divorcing after nine years of marriage. Akanksha Singh confirmed the separation during her participation in the reality show 'Lock Upp' Season 2. She stated that they are living separately and the 'couple feeling' has ended.
